text:
maria gomez: Heads up — PR 20345 (refactor/snapshot-renderer) is blocked by flaky tests in CI. SnapshotRenderer.test-loading failed on macOS-11 in two runs with different pixel diffs. Anyone with context? @kevin lee could you take a look? :eyes:

kevin lee: I'll check. Do you have the failing artifact or the test output?

maria gomez: pasted the failing snippet below
```
FAIL SnapshotRenderer.test-loading (timed out after 30s)
Expected image hash: abc123
Actual image hash: abd124
Diff: 1.2% (visual)
Stack: at renderFrame (renderer.js:412)
```
Also it's only on shard 3 and sometimes passes on rerun.

ashok patel: I saw similar in PR 19877 — usually due to async resource loading on slow bots. Increasing timeout to 60s fixed it for me. Alternatively we can force a targeted rerun. Which do you prefer?

maria gomez: I'd prefer not to change timeout if it's masking a real perf regression. Can we rerun targeted first? If it flakes consistently we'll update the test.

kevin lee: I'll trigger a targeted rerun on shard 3 now. If it fails again I'll capture the full screenshot artifact and try locally.

ci-bot: triggered targeted rerun for build 20345 on shard 3 — job id buildkite-20345-shard3-rerun-2. Link: https://ci.redwood/tests/buildkite-20345-shard3-rerun-2 :rocket:

jenny: quick note — we need 1 approver for this PR (team 'runtime'). If rerun passes can someone from runtime approve? @ashok patel? Thanks.

ashok patel: happy to approve after a green run and a quick glance at the artifact. ping me.

ci-bot: rerun completed — status: failed. Same failure reproduced. Captured artifacts at https://ci.redwood/artifacts/20345/shard3/screenshot.png

maria gomez: ok i'm going to run the test locally on sim with --headless to replicate. If I can reproduce I'll open a tiny timeout PR and flag it in the changelog.

kevin lee: if you can't reproduce, can you paste the screenshot link here? i'll try to repro in my mac vm.

maria gomez: screenshot pasted. Also filing a tracking issue: https://issues.redwood/INFR-412 — adding labels: flaky, snapshot. I'll update with local repro.

ashok patel: thanks — keep me posted. I'll hold off approving until we either fix or add a test guard.
